messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: service=inference-runtime-prod, urgency=high, incident=INC-20260315-4421. Symptoms: sustained 5xx spike on /v1/generate, median p95 latency > 2.5s, SLO error budget consuming. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-20260315-4421

alex w: Acked. I'm on it — looking at logs and scaling policy.

pagerduty: ACK by alex w at 2026-03-15T01:07:12Z

alex w: quick update: started a canary rollback of the model shard config that rolled ~02:50. If rollback doesn't help I'll scale up dedicated pool.

priya s: I'm secondary oncall — didn't get a page initially (PD shows primary routed). If Alex needs handoff pls @ me.

maria g: Observability: CPU on gpu-serve-7 spiked + queue length up x4 since 01:00. Request rate steady. Traces show KV cache misses spiking for long-context. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/metrics/inference-runtime-prod

alex w: rollback applied to 2 nodes, tailing logs:
```
2026-03-15T01:08:01Z inference-service[svc-7] ERROR generation failed 502: upstream-kernel OOM
2026-03-15T01:08:05Z inference-service[svc-7] WARN kvcache miss key=ctx-... latency=123ms
```

alex w: I'm going to scale dedicated pool by +2 GPUs and re-route 30% of traffic to fallback model-quantized. Doing now.

ops-bot: Runbook step: if 5xxs persist after rollback, toggle fallback-route and scale pool. To scale: `rdwctl pools scale inference-pool-prod +2 --reason "inc-4421"`

alex w: ran scale command: `rdwctl pools scale inference-pool-prod +2 --reason "inc-4421"` — new nodes requesting. PD note: will update.

pagerduty: Escalation: secondary/manager notified due to missed response window at 01:15Z (policy: 10m). Notifying priya s and jordan p.

priya s: I got the escalation. Alex — are you still active? I see you're online but your last message was 01:09. If you need me to take over, say so.

alex w: Sorry, quick IRL interruption, I'm back. Scaling nodes are up but still seeing 502s on edge. I want Priya to take lead on failover to quantized model; I've applied partial routing but traffic not stable. Handoff to @priya s.

priya s: Taking it. Initiating failover: bumping fallback route to 60% and enabling KV prefix caching for high-volume prefixes.

maria g: Heads up: customer-impact matrix — several mid-sized customers reporting degraded responses; 4 support tickets opened in last 10m. Publishing short incident status to status.redwood: "Degraded: inference API experiencing increased errors and latency; mitigation in progress."

priya s: Commands I'll run: 1) `rdwctl routing set inference-runtime-prod --fallback-traffic 60%` 2) `rdwctl cache enable-prefix kvprefix-prod --prefixes=dialogue-*,session-*` 3) watch traces/alerts.

priya s: Running command 1 now.

ops-bot: Command executed by priya s: `rdwctl routing set inference-runtime-prod --fallback-traffic 60%` — rollout started.

maria g: After fallback bump, 5xxs dropped from 13% -> 7% in 2 minutes. p95 latency improved ~300ms. Monitoring.

jordan p: Manager escalation: I'm pinged as part of the policy. Do you need additional capacity or a cross-team pull? I can approve emergency burst if needed.

priya s: Thanks Jordan. We're stabilizing with fallback. If error rate <5% in 10m, we keep fallback and schedule a deeper postmortem. If not, we'll request emergency burst +4 GPUs.

alex w: FYI I reopened the deployment change and flagged the model shard config for rollback review in the release playbook. Will coordinate follow-up on root cause tomorrow.

pagerduty: Incident INC-20260315-4421 acknowledged by priya s at 2026-03-15T01:22:40Z.

maria g: Noted: customer impact: degraded for 12 minutes, partial mitigation applied. Updating status page and support with ETA 30m for stable routing.

priya s: Continuing to monitor. If anyone sees new regressions, call me or DM. Thanks for quick responses. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident thread locked for 2h to prevent notification spam. Use `/incident update` to add notes.

alex w: Adding runbook note: "Potential kernel OOM after model shard change; KV cache misses amplified tail latency." Will draft postmortem template.

priya s: Closing loop — no manager override needed; Jordan acknowledged available. Will hand back to Alex for post-incident follow-up once stable.

maria g: Final metrics snapshot in 20m and I'll attach to incident card.

priya s: last check: errors ~3.2%, p95 ~1.1s. Marking "mitigated" for now.

pagerduty: Incident INC-20260315-4421 status: mitigated (post-mitigation monitoring active).
